summary: This Form 6-K filing by Kinross Gold Corporation reports a quarterly dividend declaration, a routine event under normal corporate operations. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 announces a dividend of US$0.04 per common share for Q2 2026, payable September 3, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 20, 2026. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report (Form 6-K) and does not involve any extraordinary corporate action. No deal terms or strategic reviews are present, and the dividend is part of Kinross's regular capital return policy.
